units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 14) officials of internal affairs bodies (police) and border authorities, military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.5.1 of this Code.
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 2. The list of persons authorised to carry out administrative detention under part 1 of this Article shall be established by the relevant federal executive body.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 3. At the detained person’s request, their relatives, the administration at their place of work (study), and defence counsel shall be notified of their whereabouts as soon as possible.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 4. The parents or other legal representatives of a minor must be notified of the minor’s administrative detention.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 4.1. In the event of administrative detention of a service member or a citizen called up for military training, the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the military unit where the person performs military service (military training) shall be notified immediately; in the event of administrative detention of another person referred to in part 1 of Article 2.5 of this Code, the body or institution where that person serves shall be notified immediately.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 4.2. In the event of administrative detention of a member of a public monitoring commission established under legislation of the Russian Federation, the Secretary of the Civic Chamber of the Russian Federation and the relevant public monitoring commission shall be notified immediately.
units.label: Part 4.2 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.3. Administrative detention
units.text: 5. The detained person’s rights and duties under this Code shall be explained to them, and a corresponding entry shall be made in the administrative detention record.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.3

units.locator: Article 27.4. Administrative detention record
units.text: Article 27.4. Administrative detention record
units.label: Art. 27.4

units.locator: Article 27.4. Administrative detention record
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.4. Administrative detention record
units.label: Art. 27.4

units.locator: Article 27.4. Administrative detention record
units.text: 1. An administrative detention record shall be drawn up specifying the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the detained person, and the time, place and reasons for detention.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.4

units.locator: Article 27.4. Administrative detention record
units.text: 2. The administrative detention record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and the detained person. If the detained person refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the administrative detention record shall be given to the detained person upon request.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.4

units.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.text: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.label: Art. 27.5

units.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.label: Art. 27.5

units.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.text: 1. Administrative detention shall not exceed three hours, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 - 3.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.5

units.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.text: 2. A person against whom proceedings are conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence infringing the established State Border regime of the Russian Federation or the rules for staying in the Russian Federation, an administrative offence committed in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation, or a violation of customs rules, may be subjected to administrative detention for no more than 48 hours where necessary to establish identity or ascertain the circumstances of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.5

units.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.text: 3. A person against whom proceedings are conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence punishable by administrative arrest or administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation as one of the available administrative penalties may be subjected to administrative detention for no more than 48 hours.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.5

units.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.text: 3.1. A person against whom proceedings are conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence under Article 20.5.1 of this Code may, where necessary to establish identity or ascertain the circumstances of the offence, be subjected to administrative detention for no more than 48 hours, unless otherwise established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation under Federal Constitutional Law of 30 January 2002 No. 1-FKZ “On Martial Law”.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 27.5

units.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
units.text: 4. The period of administrative detention shall run from the moment the person is conveyed under Article 27.2 of this Code. For an intoxicated person, the period of administrative detention shall run from the moment they become sober. The combined duration of sobering-up time from the moment the intoxicated person is conveyed under Article 27.2 of this Code and their administrative detention under part 2 or 3 of this Article may not exceed 48 hours.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.5

units.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
units.text: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
units.label: Art. 27.6

units.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
units.label: Art. 27.6

units.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
units.text: 1. Detained persons shall be held in specially designated premises of the bodies specified in Article 27.3 of this Code or in special institutions established in the prescribed manner by executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation. Those premises must meet sanitary requirements and prevent unauthorised departure.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.6

units.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
units.text: 2. The conditions for holding detained persons, food allowances and the procedure for providing medical care to them shall be determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.6

units.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
units.text: 3. Minors subjected to administrative detention shall be held separately from adults.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.6

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.label: Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.label: Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 1. A personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession, meaning examination of things without impairing their structural integrity, shall be carried out where necessary to discover instruments used to commit an administrative offence or objects of the offence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 2. A personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession shall be carried out by the officials specified in Articles 27.2 and 27.3 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 3. A personal search shall be conducted by a person of the same sex as the person searched, in the presence of two attesting witnesses of the same sex.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: Inspection of things in an individual’s possession (hand luggage, baggage, hunting and fishing equipment, products obtained and other objects) shall be conducted by authorised officials in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.7 · “Inspection of things in an individual’s possession (hand…”

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 4. In exceptional cases, where there are sufficient grounds to believe that an individual has weapons or other objects used as weapons in their possession, a personal search and inspection of things in the individual’s possession may be conducted without attesting witnesses.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 5. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 6. A record of the personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry shall be made in the conveyance record or administrative detention record. The search and inspection record shall specify the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the individual searched, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things, including the type, make, model, calibre, series, number and other identifying characteristics of weapons, the kind and quantity of ammunition, and the type and identifying particulars of documents found during the search or inspection in the individual’s possession.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 7. The personal search and inspection record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained using those methods during the personal search and inspection of things in the individual’s possession shall be attached to the relevant record.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
units.text: 8. The personal search and inspection record shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted or the possessor of the things inspected, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the person against whom proceedings are conducted or the possessor of the things inspected refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the personal search and inspection record shall be given to the possessor of the things inspected upon request.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27.7

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.label: Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.label: Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: 1. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and used for entrepreneurial activity, and of things and documents located there, shall be carried out by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records under Article 28.3 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: 2. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there shall be carried out in the presence of a representative of the legal entity, the individual entrepreneur or their representative, and in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: 3. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: 4. A record shall be drawn up of the inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there. It shall specify the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the legal entity and its legal representative or other representative, the individual entrepreneur or their representative, the land and premises inspected, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things, and the type and identifying particulars of documents.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: 5. The inspection record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during the inspection using those methods shall be attached to the relevant record.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
units.text: 6. The record of inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the legal representative of the legal entity or the individual entrepreneur, or, in urgent cases, another representative of the legal entity or a representative of the individual entrepreneur, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the legal representative or another representative of the legal entity, the individual entrepreneur or their representative refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the inspection record shall be given to the legal representative or another representative of the legal entity, the individual entrepreneur or their representative.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.8

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.label: Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.label: Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 1. Inspection of a vehicle of any type, meaning examination without impairing its structural integrity, shall be carried out to discover instruments used to commit an administrative offence or objects of the offence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 2. A vehicle shall be inspected by the persons specified in Articles 27.2 and 27.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 3. A vehicle shall be inspected in the presence of the person possessing it. In urgent cases, the vehicle may be inspected in that person’s absence.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 4. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 5. A vehicle inspection record shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry shall be made in the administrative detention record.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 6. The vehicle inspection record shall specify the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the person possessing the vehicle inspected, the type, make, model, state registration number and other identifying characteristics of the vehicle, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things, including the type, make, model, calibre, series, number and other identifying characteristics of weapons, the kind and quantity of ammunition, and the type and identifying particulars of documents found during inspection of the vehicle.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 7. The vehicle inspection record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during the inspection using those methods shall be attached to the relevant record.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle
units.text: 8. The vehicle inspection record shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted and/or the person possessing the vehicle inspected, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the person against whom proceedings are conducted and/or the person possessing the vehicle inspected refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the vehicle inspection record shall be given to the person possessing the vehicle inspected.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27.9

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.label: Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.label: Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 1. Things used as instruments to commit an administrative offence or constituting its objects, and documents having evidentiary value in an administrative offence case, found at the scene of the offence or during a personal search, inspection of things in an individual’s possession or vehicle inspection, shall be seized by the persons specified in Articles 27.2, 27.3 and 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 2. Things used as instruments to commit an administrative offence or constituting its objects, and documents having evidentiary value in an administrative offence case, found during inspection of land and premises belonging to a legal entity and of goods, vehicles and other property in its possession and the relevant documents, shall be seized by the persons specified in Article 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 3. Repealed from 1 September 2013. — Federal Law of 23.07.2013 No. 196-FZ.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 4. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used when seizing things and documents.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 5. A record of seizure of things and documents shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry shall be made in the conveyance record, the record of inspection of the scene of the administrative offence or the administrative detention record. Seizure of a driving licence, tractor driver-operator (tractor driver) certificate, vessel operator certificate or pilot certificate shall be entered in the administrative offence record or the record of inspection of the scene of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 5.1. Where documents are seized, copies shall be made, certified by the official seizing them and given to the person from whom they are seized, and this shall be entered in the record. If copies cannot be made or handed over at the same time as seizure, that official shall give certified copies to the person from whom the documents were seized within five days after seizure, and this shall be entered in the record. If certified copies have not been given to that person by the expiry of five days after seizure, they shall be sent by registered mail within three days, and an entry specifying the postal item number shall be made in the record. Copies shall be sent to the legal entity’s address or the individual’s residential address specified in the record.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 6. The seizure record shall specify the type and identifying particulars of the documents seized, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things seized, including the type, make, model, calibre, series, number and other identifying characteristics of weapons, and the kind and quantity of ammunition.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 7. The seizure record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording documents. Materials obtained during seizure using photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be attached to the relevant record.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 8. The seizure record shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the person from whom things and documents were seized, except where that person is outside the Russian Federation and their signature cannot be obtained under part 10 of Article 24.9 of this Code, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the person from whom things and documents were seized refuses to sign, or is outside the Russian Federation and their signature cannot be obtained under part 10 of Article 24.9 of this Code, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy shall be given to the person from whom things and documents were seized or their legal representative.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 9. Where necessary, things and documents seized shall be packaged and sealed at the place of seizure. Until consideration of the administrative offence case, they shall be stored at places determined by the person who seized them, in accordance with the procedure established by the relevant federal executive body.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 27.10
